rationale: The agent authenticated the user correctly via email and operated only on the user’s own orders. It checked order details and product variants, correctly executed the makeup kit swap after explicitly confirming the change and charging the price difference. However, it violated policy by performing two order-changing writes without prior explicit confirmation after stating the exact change: (1) it updated the shipping address on #W5056519 immediately after retrieving the address from #W8277957 without asking the user to confirm the specific new address; (2) it canceled order #W5995614 immediately after the request, again without an explicit confirmation prompt. These actions breach the requirement to confirm before any order-changing write. Other details provided appear consistent with tool outputs, but the confirmation lapses mean the outcome does not meet the pass bar.
